name: m-work
positioning: Smart workforce management and hybrid work software that decides who works where and when, and builds the schedule to match.
description: m-work is a French software suite for planning flex offices and hybrid teams. Its m-work Flex product manages hot desking, meeting-room and resource booking, and remote-work declarations, syncing with Outlook and Google Calendar so a workplace or HR team can see who is in which office on a given day. A second product, m-work Planner, forecasts activity volume and builds shift schedules for customer-facing teams. The company was acquired by French HR software group Asys in 2026 and continues to operate as a distinct product line.
real_estate_use: A corporate real estate or workplace team uses m-work Flex to monitor office occupancy in real time and reorganize desks, meeting rooms and parking as hybrid attendance shifts, instead of guessing capacity from badge data alone. An HR team relies on the same tool to track remote-work declarations against company policy and to generate a work-from-home allowance from actual attendance. A facilities manager configures smart rules so hot-desk bookings stay fair across teams as office footprint is reduced.
features: Hot desking and resource booking (desks, meeting rooms, parking)
Hybrid work schedule and remote-work declaration tracking
Real-time office occupancy monitoring and dashboards
Outlook and Google Calendar sync, SSO
m-work Planner: activity forecasting and shift scheduling for frontline teams
Remote-work policy and WFH allowance calculators

use_cases.job: Track real-time office occupancy and resize flex-office capacity as hybrid attendance changes
Manage hot-desk, meeting-room and parking bookings fairly across teams sharing the same space
